_provenance.warning: Answer key. Never place this file, or any part of it, inside mock-company/. A product run must not be able to read it.
_provenance.what: Per complaint: the defensible value of each mandated field, and the honest state of each empty one.

mandated_field_citations.date_received: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(2) / ISO 13485 8.2.2 - the regulated receipt date
mandated_field_citations.complainant: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(4) - name, address, phone of the complainant
mandated_field_citations.allegation_verbatim: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(5) - the complaint in the complainant's own words
mandated_field_citations.product_model: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(1) - the name of the device
mandated_field_citations.device_identifiers: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(3) - UDI/UPC and any other device identification
mandated_field_citations.reply: 21 CFR 820.198(e)(7) - any reply to the complainant
mandated_field_citations.date_of_event: MIR 1.2 / MDCG 2023-3 - the date the incident occurred

empty_state_vocabulary.value: a value is recorded and a source states it
empty_state_vocabulary.explicitly_unknown: someone looked, and the answer is that it cannot be known from the reporter - e.g. the nurse did not read the UDI off the label, the pouch is in clinical waste
empty_state_vocabulary.not_yet_investigated: nobody has looked yet. The field is open work, not a closed gap.
empty_state_vocabulary.why_the_distinction_is_scored: 21 CFR 803.52(f)(11)(iii) and 803.50(b)(3) both require the manufacturer to say why a required field is empty and what was done to fill it. A product that collapses the two states cannot draft that statement, and cannot tell an auditor the difference between a dead end and an open action.

rendered_vocabulary.note: 'Not provided' is written where someone looked and the answer cannot be had; 'Not yet established' is written where nobody has looked yet. The two phrases never cross, so a product can tell them apart from the record alone - and a product that collapses them into one 'unknown' has thrown away information the source carried.

reportability_coverage.correct_answer: This is a fact about the company, not a hole in the data. US market entry was February 2026, the RA specialist started in March, and the effective vigilance procedure contains no 21 CFR Part 803 content at all. Reporting the gap is a day-one finding. Drafting the missing determinations and presenting them as the register's is fabrication - see SCORING.md N2.
